name: Holi
tagline: Clouds of color, laughter and spring celebration.
description: The festival of colors in full joy: bursts of gulal, color-streaked white kurtas, dhol rhythms, rooftop celebrations, gujiya and thandai and that blissful after-Holi grin. Bright spring sunlight and colors frozen mid-air.
